Safety profile shows expected toxicities without dose-limiting issues. This is a straightforward efficacy failure without clear mechanistic insights due to lack of biomarker data.

failure_modes.evidence: Primary endpoint PFS missed with HR 0.906 (p=0.492) despite adequate sample size and duration. Without biomarker data, cannot definitively place failure in causal chain, but the combination rationale suggests biological activity was expected but didn't translate to clinical benefit.
